notes.title: PATCH 0.24.71
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Pet System[/b][/h1]

Prepare to unlock new bonds, discover hidden potentials, and traverse uncharted territories alongside your faithful companions. With enhanced features and mysterious surprises awaiting, the adventure awaits those daring enough to explore the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/5a111f460ebe61c5890418b23de0b05f6c78d72a.gif[/img]

The Pet System is a "[i]quality of life (QOL)[/i]" system, which should help you progress without giving you major stat boosts.

[list]
[*] 64 Pets to unlock
[*] Different pet traits to mix and match
[*] Collect all pets to unlock bonuses
[*] Evolve the pets and build the ultimate companion
[/list]


[h2][h1]Pet Traits[/h1][/h2]

[b]Shapeshifter[/b]
This pet trait allows you to turn into the pet itself, moving faster and ignoring enemy collision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/37fcdf194c117652ae7f5fe54a16a06a2ff11923.gif[/img]

[b]Soulfetcher[/b]
This pet trait allows you to collect the souls of bosses weaker bosses, allowing you to progress with minimal backtracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/a950d95601269c3864f33c2987bdf7c8de1715f4.gif[/img]

[b]Blinker[/b]
This pet trait allows you to teleport to maps you've already visited, making it easier to kill bosses you left for later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/4e577a800f9655e68c56e3c31033decd66712afe.gif[/img]

[b]Shopper[/b]
This pet trait gives you a discount when buying any gear or relic.


[h2]Managing Traits[/h2]
Traits are limited by the pet rarity, each rarity has a limit of how many traits your pet can have, the maximum rank it can achieve, and which traits the pet can unlock.
[list]
[*] [b]COMMON[/b]: Can only unlock one trait, the max rank is 3
[*] [b]RARE[/b]: Can unlock two traits, the max rank is 5
[*] [b]EPIC[/b]: Can unlock two traits, the max rank is 7, can unlock the Soulfetcher trait
[*] [b]LEGENDARY[/b]: Can unlock three traits, the max rank is 10, can unlock the Soulfetcher trait
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/e66cca26cf38ca9b1dfe0abd1241cdc3c559ce58.gif[/img]


[h2]Rank[/h2]
When battling, your pet will gain experience with you. For each monster you defeat, the pet will earn 1 exp (2 for bosses), this value can be affected by the "All or Nothing" skill.


[h2]Aether[/h2]
A new currency harvested from pets. You can set a pet free and get an amount of Aether based on the pet Rank and rarity. You can use Aether to upgrade a pet rank without bringing it to battles.


[h2]Codex[/h2]
There area 64 pets to collect. By collecting a certain amount of pets you'll receive a bonus, being:

[list]
[*] Wild Pets: +1%, +2%, +3% and +4% EXP (10% total)
[*] Unique Pets: +1%, +2%, +3% and +4% GOLD (10% total)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/e388bfd99c11b8d8ad06dddd43485aabfd4b58e7.gif[/img]

[h2]Hatching[/h2]
There are two ways you can hatch a Pet:
[list]
[*] By dropping an egg from monsters
[*] By buying eggs with Tickets
[/list]

When hatching you'll get a random pet, the only way to know which pet you will get is by killing mobs with the "[i]paw[/i]" icon, these mobs are certain to drop an egg that will hatch the corresponding pet.

That's all for now, feel free to ask questions on our discord channel:
https://discord.gg/krTgX2y27J

notes.title: Hero's Quest is OUT!
notes.notes:
Get ready for an epic adventure with Hero's Quest! Explore dangerous worlds and battle fierce bosses, all while managing your energy levels and gathering gold to upgrade your equipment. With multiple heroes to choose from, you get to be whoever you want to be on this quest.

With each run, you'll uncover more about the world and its secrets.

Don't let your energy run out! With each battle costing one point, you'll need to be strategic and make every move count. But don't worry, you don't have to start from scratch if your energy runs out - your equipment upgrades will persist through each run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/369d468dbfdddabfaad9d52d56984fd814263a2b.png[/img]

Are you ready to take on the ultimate challenge and become a legend in Hero's Quest? Get Hero's Quest today and be the first to embark on this epic journey!

notes.title: Hero's Quest Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Deck Compatibility[/h1]
Great news, gamers! I'm excited to announce that Hero's Quest is fully compatible with the Steam Deck. 

Not only does the game run smoothly on the device, but it also has low power consumption, ensuring that you can enjoy hours of gameplay without worrying about draining the battery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/cdac93e4076f3dc9e1cb9c344af6eaf0e11f602c.jpg[/img]

Hero's Quest also has full gamepad support, so you can easily control your character and play the game using the built-in controllers on the Steam Deck. Plus, thanks to the device's suspend/resume feature, you can pause your game and pick it up right where you left off, without any issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/b5d709d9ebaaed4b112a66fe3283781c7170721b.jpg[/img]

The game is designed to look great on a variety of different screen sizes, and that includes the 7-inch display on the Steam Deck. The game's menus and controls are easy to navigate, and all of the in-game graphics and text are perfectly scaled to fit the device's screen. Whether you're exploring new worlds or battling monsters, you can expect a seamless and immersive gaming experience that takes full advantage of the Steam Deck's display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/718a14ed22fc831514a1a215784cd3ed818261ba.jpg[/img]

Grab your Steam Deck and get on your next Hero's Quest adventure!
